title: feat(lint)!: the two page component rules run on the runtime publish door (ruling B)
body:
Fixes #23388

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Ruling of record `6161173492` (letter B), quoting the maintainer: 「23388 B 是不是最简单？」「23388 如果页面有问题，不是应该修改了再保存吗？」

## What changes

- **`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`:** `validateComponentProps` and `validateComponentTypes` go from `surfaces: CLI_ONLY` to `CLI_AND_RUNTIME`, with `runtimeTypes: ['page']` (ruling items 1 and 2). Both entry comments drop the #4716 stored-row false-refusal discipline and the two pending `surfaceReason`s, and cite this ruling as the ruling of record (item 3). The `validatePrintPageBlocks` entry comment said "the false-refusal budget `validateComponentTypes` is held on"; it now says that budget was replaced by this ruling. The rules' own code and `ComponentPropsMap` are not touched.
- **Header lines (item 3):** the header lines the dispatch pointed at (~494-511, `RUNTIME_OBJECT_ADVISORY_VOLUME`) describe the #4716 split of the OBJECT rules, not these two page rules. They are still true and are not rewritten. No other header line in the file names these two rules.
- **The crossing needed no mechanism edit.** `page` already maps to `pages` in `TYPE_TO_STACK_KEY`. The runtime gate judges a finding located on the written item against the baseline without the item, so the next save of a stored page with a finding is that save's own finding. The read and boot path runs no authoring rule.
- **Pins (item 4)** are in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` and run through the real `saveMetaItem` / `publishMetaItem` / `loadMetaFromDb` / `getMetaItem`:
  - (a) An active save of a page whose `page:header` carries `titel` is refused with `422 INVALID_METADATA`, rule `component-props-unknown-key` at `pages[0].regions[0].components[0].properties.titel`. The message carries `` `titel` → `title` `` and the hint carries `` Remove `titel` ``. Nothing is stored. The draft-to-active promotion of the same page is refused the same way.
  - (c) A component typed `page:headr` is refused with `422`, rule `component-type-unknown`, hint exactly ``Rename `page:headr` → `page:header`.``
  - Control: the declared spelling saves, and so does `acme:pipeline_board`, a type outside the reserved namespaces.
  - (b) A page row carrying both findings is seeded into the store. Then: `loadMetaFromDb` returns `loaded: 1, errors: 0, invalid: 0` and registers the page; `getMetaItem` serves the stored body; the next save of the same body is refused with both rule ids and the stored row is unchanged; the fixed page then saves. This mirrors the precedent sentence at `18.page-default-record-page-one-per-object-refused.ts:42`.
- **Changeset (item 5):** `.changeset/23388-page-component-rules-runtime-door.md`. `@objectstack/lint` gets `minor` with the BREAKING banner, and `@objectstack/spec` gets `patch` (text only). It carries the ruling's sentence verbatim and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (already-registered …)`, listing the same D3 ids the 23147 changeset names. The card's step ① (a stored-row listing) is not built.

## Overlap with #23357 (ruling item 6, for the seat)

Once this lands, #23357's narrow judge (the retired page data binding, in `packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts` / `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) overlaps the general rule at the save door. One operation has two implementations, and the governed side wins. I did not touch it, because seat 1 holds those files. The same seat should fix one sentence while it is in those files: `validate-component-props.ts:111-116` ("The runtime publish door … does not run this rule") becomes false with this PR.

## File surface beyond the claim, and why

Ruling item 3 limits the rewrite to `authoring-rules.ts`. My change also made the texts below false, and os-dev requires a published text that a change makes false to be fixed in that same change, so I corrected them here:

- **`packages/lint/src/validate-print-page-blocks.ts`** and **`packages/lint/src/validate-component-types.ts`** headers: comment-only. Each named the props/types rules' pending stored-row budget or `surfaceReason`.
- **24 step-18 D3 entries** under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-*`, `18.element-data-source-and-object-block-filter-rule-array.ts`, and **`packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template`**: these are shipped upgrade-guide and `os migrate meta` text. Each said "a stored page still saves and loads, because a page component's `properties` is not parsed on the metadata save or load path", or for one entry "a re-save through the metadata API is not refused there". After this PR, the next save of such a page is refused by the component-props gate at the save door. Each now says the page still loads and that its next save meets the component-props gate at the metadata save door. Code comments that said "a stored page is never refused" now say "never refused at load". Text only: no key, schema or conversion changes. No committed generated artifact moves (`registry.ts` is gitignored, and `check:spec-changes` / `check:upgrade-guide` are green).
- One more now-false sentence is NOT fixed, because #23332 holds that file: the doc comment on the `object-grid` export-options row at `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:5991-5994` ("a stored page still saves and loads"). It is a comment, not runtime text.

## Deliberate correction of pending changesets

`check:empty-changeset` is **red by design**: this PR changes two pending changesets it did not add, and those sentences became false because of this PR's diff. I added no label. The seat decides at review, against the head sha.

1. **`.changeset/23147-component-props-every-finding-refused.md`**
   - Before: "**Not judged here.** The runtime publish door (the Studio, REST `/meta`, MCP) does not run this rule, so a page saved there is not refused for any of these. `defineStack` and the stack schema keep the open `properties` bag as written. …"
   - After: "**Not judged here.** `defineStack` and the stack schema keep the open `properties` bag as written. …"
   - What makes the before false: `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, the `validateComponentProps` entry, `-    surfaces: CLI_ONLY,` becomes `+    surfaces: CLI_AND_RUNTIME,` / `+    runtimeTypes: ['page'],`.
2. **`.changeset/23103-page-action-row-on-success-and-executor.md`**
   - Before: "… as a `component-props-invalid` finding (an error, like every finding of that gate). A stored page still saves and loads."
   - After: "… as a `component-props-invalid` finding (an error, like every finding of that gate). A stored page still loads; the metadata save door runs the same gate, so the next save of a page carrying a refused row is refused with the same text."
   - What makes the before false: the same `validateComponentProps` line in `authoring-rules.ts`.

The gate's exact failing output (`node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, exit 1, at `ba20e780e`):

```text
This PR changes a changeset it did not add:

   .changeset/23103-page-action-row-on-success-and-executor.md
     present on the merge base and CHANGED by this PR -- this is somebody else's release note
   .changeset/23147-component-props-every-finding-refused.md
     present on the merge base and CHANGED by this PR -- this is somebody else's release note
```

It ends with one `::error file=…` annotation for each of the two files: "… exists on the merge base and was not added by this PR … DELIBERATE CORRECTION -- your change may have made this PENDING release note false, and you rewrote it in the same stroke. Remedy: do NOT restore it -- say so on the PR and get it confirmed …"

## Acceptance notes

- **Door asymmetry, measured.** These two rules run at the CLI at the `normalized` tier, after ADR-0087 D2 conversions. The save door judges the body as sent. I ran both rules over every conversion fixture with a `pages` stack (31 of 136 conversions), raw against normalized:
  - 29 give identical verdicts.
  - Two live-window aliases differ: `page-header-subtitle-alias` (`page:header` `description`, 5 raw-only findings) and `inline-action-api-params-to-body-extra` (an inline api action's object `params`, 3 raw-only).
  - Both declare `toMajor: 17`, so their window runs out at 18 (`retiresIn = toMajor + 1`), but neither is `retiredFromLoadPath` yet. Until that happens, a save spelling them is refused with the canonical key (for example, "Did you mean `description` → `subtitle`?"), while `os validate` converts them.
  - The changeset says so. Stored rows are rehydrated through the conversions on read, so a Studio round-trip sends back the canonical spelling.
- The objectui page designer writes no component props, per the director's reading in the ruling.

## Verification (head `ba20e780e`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 138 files, 6699 tests passed. `typecheck` passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 235 files passed, 3 skipped; 28368 tests passed, 19 skipped. `typecheck` passed.
- Consumers that save pages through the door: `@objectstack/objectql` (`default-record-page-save-door`, `protocol-meta`) 113 passed; `@objectstack/rest` (`meta-alternate-door-read-gates`, `meta-history-diff-authoring-door`, `meta-plural-i18n`, `rest`) 667 passed; `@objectstack/runtime` (`domains/meta-list-projection-parity`) 739 passed.
- `@objectstack/spec`: `vitest --project local` over `src/migrations`, `src/conversions` and `src/stack-conversions-record.test.ts`, 763 passed; `test:repo`, 59 files, 1011 tests passed.
- **Ablation:** done with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed), then a lint rebuild and `ablation-dist-preflight` (marker present in 4 built files).
  - `validateComponentProps` back on `CLI_ONLY`: (a), the draft promotion and (b) go red; (c) and the control stay green.
  - `validateComponentTypes` back on `CLI_ONLY`: (c) and (b) go red, and (a) goes red too (its `rulesRun` assertion names both rules).
  - Restore leg: `git checkout HEAD`, hash equal to the HEAD blob, rebuild, both markers `--absent`, and the 5 pins pass.
- **Derived gates** (`dispatch-gates --ran`): 89 derived; 85 run, 4 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.
  - Red: `check-empty-changeset` (by design, above).
  - NOT MEASURED:
    - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: shallow clone, so the pinned control commit is unreachable.
    - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: needs a whole-repo build.
    - `check:type-check-debt`: its re-measure build was OOM-killed (137) on the shared box.
    - `check:query-options-erasure`: the whole-repo eslint ratchet was killed by a 240 s timeout.
  - All other gates exit 0.
